OPENCOMPUTER_API_KEY.description: Your OpenComputer organization API key. Server only.

OPENCOMPUTER_PROJECT_ID.description: The OpenComputer project id written to `.opencomputer/project.json` by `npx opencomputer link`.

OPENCOMPUTER_ENVIRONMENT.description: `development` or `production`: the environment of that project the workbench uses.

OPENCOMPUTER_AGENT_ID.description: The worker agent's id in that project, from `.opencomputer/project.json`.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: The client id of the GitHub OAuth app used for sign-in; its callback URL is `<origin>/auth/callback`.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The client secret of that OAuth app. Server only.

WORKBENCH_COOKIE_KEY.description: Base64 of 32 random bytes (`openssl rand -base64 32`) that encrypts the session cookie; rotating it signs everyone out.

WORKBENCH_MEMBERSHIP.description: Who may sign in: `org:<id>`, `team:<org id>/<team id>` or `user:<id>` with numeric GitHub ids; `npm run membership-id -- team:<org>/<slug>` prints it.

WORKBENCH_ORIGIN.description: The Worker's public origin, for the OAuth callback and the origin check on every POST and PATCH.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
